archetype: ORGANIC & EARTHY - Cocoa Heritage Ledger & Senior-Friendly Business Record System

theme_strategy.mode: Light Warm Parchment default with High-Contrast Dark Cocoa toggle option
theme_strategy.target_user: 70-year-old Cocoa Business Owner & trusted staff (Needs ultra-legible typography, large high-contrast inputs, touch-friendly 52px+ action buttons, intuitive warmth, and explicit confirmation safety locks against accidental edits)

accessibility_rules: Minimum body font size 16px (1rem), standard body at 18px for maximum legibility by senior user
All text colors must meet WCAG AAA / APCA high contrast rules against backgrounds (minimum contrast 7:1)
Never use subtle light gray text on light backgrounds; use rich espresso (#2C1A11) or deep bronze (#3D271D)
Interactive buttons must use minimum 18px bold text with clear icon labels

role_mapping.stat_card: bg-white border-2 border-[#8C6D58]/30 shadow-md rounded-xl p-6 hover:border-[#8C4A27]
role_mapping.primary_button: bg-[#8C4A27] hover:bg-[#3B1E10] text-white font-bold py-3 px-6 rounded-lg text-lg shadow-md transition-colors border-2 border-[#3B1E10]/20
role_mapping.secondary_button: bg-[#F4ECE1] hover:bg-[#E3D5C5] text-[#24140E] font-semibold py-3 px-5 rounded-lg text-lg border-2 border-[#8C6D58]/40
role_mapping.danger_button: bg-[#991B1B] hover:bg-[#7F1D1D] text-white font-bold py-3 px-5 rounded-lg text-lg rounded-lg border-2 border-[#7F1D1D]
role_mapping.input_field: bg-white border-2 border-[#8C6D58] text-[#24140E] text-lg rounded-lg p-3 focus:ring-4 focus:ring-[#8C4A27]/30 focus:border-[#8C4A27]

visual_enhancers.textures: Subtle organic warm parchment feel, rich dark wood border accents, high-contrast cocoa bean badge icons

safety_locks.description: To protect against accidental edits by senior owner or staff, editing and deleting actions are locked by default with an explicit 'Unlock Edits' switch + two-step confirmation modal.
safety_locks.visual_indicator: Locked fields show a padlocked badge with clear text 'Read-Only (Click Unlock to edit)'

built_in_calculator.location: Embedded inside Customer Profile and Cocoa Records page
built_in_calculator.features: Quick calculate bags to kg (e.g. 1 bag ~ 64kg), NGN money owed calculation (kg x price), debt balance reduction preview

header.style: High-contrast sticky topbar in deep cocoa brown (#3B1E10), with clear brand logo, store status, live session timer, user role switcher (Admin / Staff), and prominent navigation tabs

tiles.title: Live Cocoa Buying Rate
tiles.rule: CRITICAL: Do NOT show the actual price value on dashboard. Show 'CONFIDENTIAL RATE - Click/Tap to view on Private Rate Page' with a lock icon to maintain business privacy.

login_screen.demo_switch: Include quick demo role switcher for immediate testing without hassle

customers_page.sequential_id_rule: Every customer has a permanent, sequential, zero-padded ID (001, 002, 003...)
customers_page.search_filter: Search by Customer ID (001), Full Name, Phone number, Caretaker name

customer_profile.caretakers: Supports listing multiple caretakers (e.g., 'Brother / Farm Manager')
customer_profile.debt_section: Displays total money owed (NGN ₦), detailed list of debt reasons (e.g., 'Pre-season loan', 'Fertilizer advance')
customer_profile.repayment_history: Complete ledger of payments, date, amount paid, staff receiver, receipt note
customer_profile.built_in_calculator: Interactive Cocoa Debt & Bag Converter calculator integrated directly into profile for instant math
customer_profile.safety: Locked against accidental edits; requires clicking 'Enable Editing' switch to modify record details

cocoa_store_records.concept: CRITICAL RULE: Cocoa arriving at store does NOT belong to a customer just because they brought or delivered it. It is recorded as general store arrivals stock with scaling state.

arrival_entry_form.unscaled_flag: If marked Unscaled, entry highlights prominently in red/amber with a prominent 'Enter Weight Now' action button

cocoa_store_records.store_summary: Human-readable description of current cocoa in store (e.g., 'Store holds 4,250 kg scaled cocoa across 66 bags, plus 4 unscaled deliveries awaiting weighing balance.')
cocoa_store_records.daily_history: Filterable history log by Date range, Scaled vs Unscaled status

cocoa_rate_page.purpose: Dedicated private page showing official buying rate per kg
features: Admin edit rate form with price history log
Rate calculator for quick total payout simulation

admin_staff_management.purpose: Admin owner can manage staff access

instructions_to_main_agent: Follow all guidelines specified in this json file precisely.
Implement high-contrast senior-friendly UI with clean 18px+ text and generous line height.
Strictly follow the 'Clickable Cocoa Rate' dashboard tile rule: DO NOT display the numeric cocoa price on the dashboard; display a lock icon + button leading to /cocoa-rate.
Ensure Cocoa Store Records clearly state that cocoa arriving does NOT automatically belong to a customer.
Ensure sequential zero-padded IDs (001, 002, 003...) for all customers.
Include a built-in cocoa/debt calculator inside the customer profile view and store records page.
Include safety mechanisms: edit unlock toggle button and explicit confirmation modals on dangerous actions.
Make sure all interactive and key data elements have data-testid attributes.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur) where appropriate
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g., transition: all). Exclude transforms.
You MUST NOT center align the app container
Always use modern button styles with clear text labels and minimum 48px touch height for accessibility
NEVER use AI assistant emoji characters for icons; use Lucide or Phosphor icons
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, entrance animations
All interactive elements MUST include data-testid attributes
